evidence.summary: BeyondSquare Solutions, the Bengaluru company behind FinAlyzer, raised US$4 million in a Series A round led by Avant Global Corporation, announced 2025-09-17. Proceeds strengthen FinAlyzer's automation, compliance intelligence and scalability for enterprises with complex reporting structures, and expand its footprint in the Middle East, Europe and Southeast Asia. Entrackr confirms the $4M Series A led by Avant Global, executed in three stages (new/convertible shares, existing-shareholder subscriptions, warrant conversion).
